changelog: Aura AI v2.4.1 — Smoothness & Performance, Real Recents Management, In-Built Browser, & Voice Persistence
App Smoothness & Zero-Lag Fix: Throttled accessibility micro-events, eliminated main-thread tree crawling, restored fluid 60-120 FPS scrolling
Recents Dismissal & Background Media Silence: New close_app tool pauses playing media and dismisses app cards or clears all recents via hardware gesture
Native Text Injection: Strict directive prohibiting screen-share prompts for typing/clicking; injects text directly into active focus fields
Complete Voice Lifecycle & Orb States: Connecting -> Idle (Ask anything) -> Listening -> Thinking -> Working -> Speaking; eliminated idle orb vibration
Persistent Voice Sessions in Drawer: Persisted locally via VoiceSessionStore; review complete voice chats with tool calls from Drawer -> Voice
In-Built Web Browser Support: open_inbuilt_browser routes web pages directly into Aura's internal browser tab instead of external Chrome
System App & Dialer Intent Routing: Fixed 'phone dialer' URL error, prevented PhonePe collisions on 'phone' queries, and added system dialer intent fallbacks
Always-Visible New Chat Suggestions: Adjusted height constraints so suggestion chips remain visible on all mobile screen heights
